description: NASA Ames poster surveying unit-cell geometries and joint systems for robotically assembled lattice structures: seven candidate cell geometries, adjacency/attachment trade space, and the androgynous captive fastener (ACF) prototype. Qualitative - it names the joint metrics that matter (proof load, shear load, mass, loading area) but publishes no numbers for them. 1 page.

notes: Historical retrieval notes (PDF no longer redistributed): Kept because the project's node-mass question (the largest unsourced number left on the cell page) needs a real joint design to settle it, and this is the NASA line of work that produced one - the captive-fastener concept here is what ARMADAS flew six years later, where its measured price was 27.8% of assembled mass. Do not cite this poster for numbers; it contains none that this project uses. A related IEEE Aerospace paper by the same group exists; this is the NTRS poster, not that paper.
